limits: Temporary hosted research only; close without merging after retaining immutable evidence.
Five exact owning executable checks and twenty-one distinct exact headless library parents only; planned counts are not execution results.
Formatting is UNRUN and not established by this workflow. Separate exact-head formatter evidence and full PR formatting gates are not waived.

No whole feature suite, native interaction, screenshots, performance, integrated-browser, commercial provider or merge acceptance. The #1627 offline self-exec lifecycle fixture is narrower than native/product acceptance.
All commands and sources run sequentially; UI and HOST remain separate invocations and target directories.

An ordinary product command or exact-parent oracle failure stops only that product and preserves aggregate failure while later independent products run serially. Context, source, configuration and uncertain timeout/signal/wrapper failures stop globally.

Qualified parent counts require the original successful command and exact one-pass oracle. Unrun selector invocations were never reached; a failed invocation may fail compilation before its parent executes, so its raw test outcome remains separate.
Natural hosted User context is required; inherited CAGENTS_ names are refused, never removed.
GNU timeout bounds each command; its wrapper return and direct completion are recorded. No detached-process census or whole-family closure is claimed.
No local build, test, provider, daemon or native execution is authorized by this research file.
